 / Yatra-kāma-avasāyitvaṃ satya-
saṃkalpatā yathā saṃkalpas tathā bhūta-prakṛtīnām avasthānam / Na ca śakto'pi padārtha-
viparyāsaṃ karoti / Kasmāt ? / Anyasya yatra-kāma-avasāyinaḥ pūrva-siddhasya tathā-
bhūteṣu saṃkalpād iti / Etāny aṣṭāv aiśvaryāṇi /
2° Kāya-saṃpad vakṣyamāṇā
3° tad-dharma-anabhighātaś ca pṛthivī mūrtyā na niruṇaddhi yoginaḥ śarīra-ādi-kriyām
śilām apy anuviśati–iti / Na–āpaḥ snigdhāḥ kledayanti / Na–agnir uṣṇo dahati / Na vāyuḥ
praṇāmī vahaty anāvaraṇa-ātmake'py ākāśe bhavaty āvṛtta-kāyaḥ siddhānām apy adṛśyo
bhavati /45/
